name: 笔记
description: 现代闪念速记：极简无标题随手记、就地快速编辑、支持设置定时提醒，笔记与日历双视图合一。顶栏按钮打开全局浮窗，配合 AI 工具随时捕捉灵感与备忘。
descriptionEn: Modern quick-capture notes: frictionless title-free memos, rapid inline editing, scheduled reminders, and integrated notes & calendar tabs. A floating panel plus AI tools to capture ideas anytime.

settings.label: 镜像成 Markdown 文件（Mirror to Markdown）
settings.hint: 每次改动把每篇笔记写成一个 .md，另生成 _todos.md / _reminders.md 两个汇总，放到下面那个目录里 —— 给 Obsidian / git 用。注意是**单向导出**：真相仍在插件自己的 json 库里，改镜像文件不会回流。
settings.hintEn: On every change, write each note as one .md plus _todos.md / _reminders.md summaries into the directory below — for Obsidian / git. Note this is **one-way export**: the plugin's own JSON store stays the source of truth; editing mirrored files never flows back.

settings.label: 镜像目录（绝对路径）
settings.hint: 例如 D:/notes-vault/pi-notes。工作区外的目录首次写入时浏览器会弹一次授权确认；清理只删我们自己在 .pi-notes-mirror.json 索引里记过的文件。
settings.hintEn: E.g. D:/notes-vault/pi-notes. Directories outside the workspace ask for authorization once on first write; cleanup only removes files tracked in our own .pi-notes-mirror.json index.
